caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted bust of a human head and neck, colored entirely in shades of brown. The bust has straight, chin-length hair with detailed lines indicating individual strands and texture. The facial features include closed eyes, a pronounced nose with distinctive shaping and lines, a closed mouth with a neutral expression, and lightly defined ears. The surface of the face and neck shows several lines and marks suggestive of texture or possible damage. The neck transitions smoothly into a rounded, broad base with horizontal segments illustrated, resembling a collar or a pedestal. The background is plain and a light beige color, making the brown tones of the bust stand out clearly. There are no additional objects or elements in the drawing.
title: Bust of P.J. Landry
